installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
cd /mnt/server

if [ "$RW_MULTIPLAYER_VERSION" == "beta" ]; then
    RW_MULTIPLAYER_VERSION="continuous"
elif [[ "$RW_MULTIPLAYER_VERSION" != v* ]]; then
    RW_MULTIPLAYER_VERSION="v${RW_MULTIPLAYER_VERSION}"
fi

# Fetch the download URL for the Server asset
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/rwmt/Multiplayer/releases/tags/$RW_MULTIPLAYER_VERSION" \
    | grep "browser_download_url" \
    | cut -d '"' -f 4 \
    | grep -i -m 1 "Server.*\.zip$")

if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ]; then
    echo "Error: Could not find a Server zip asset for version $RW_MULTIPLAYER_VERSION."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloading Multiplayer server version $RW_MULTIPLAYER_VERSION..."
curl -L -o "server.zip" "$DOWNLOAD_URL"
unzip -o "server.zip"
rm "server.zip"

mv Server/Linux/* .
rm -rf Server

cat << EOF > settings.toml
gameName = "${RW_GAME_NAME}"
lanAddress = "127.0.0.1"
directAddress = "0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT}"
maxPlayers = ${RW_MAX_PLAYERS}
autosaveInterval = 1.0
autosaveUnit = "Days"
steam = false
direct = true
lan = false
asyncTime = ${RW_ASYNC_TIME}
multifaction = ${RW_MULTIFCATION}
debugMode = false
desyncTraces = true
syncConfigs = ${RW_SYNC_CONFIGS}
autoJoinPoint = "Join, Desync"
devModeScope = "HostOnly"
hasPassword = ${RW_PASSWORD_REQUIRED}
password = "${RW_PASSWORD}"
pauseOnLetter = "AnyThreat"
pauseOnJoin = true
pauseOnDesync = true
timeControl = "${RW_TIME_CONTROL}"
EOF

variables.description: The max amount of players allowed to be connected

variables.description: If a password should be enabled

variables.description: If multiple factions should be creatable

variables.description: If time should be asynchronous in tiles

variables.description: Who should be able to control time

The multiplayer version to install
